subject: The vulnerability policy file contains the init ignore rules
source:
uv run python -c 'from pathlib import Path
policy = Path("SECURITY.md").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
assert "retornatus-gitignore:begin" in policy
assert ".retornatus/index/" in policy
assert "*.pem" in policy
assert "!.env.example" in policy
assert ".retornatus/keys/*.pub" in policy
print("vulnerability policy ok")'
